title: Jake Barber's consciousness contact with the egg

tellings.quote: Jake had that consciousness contact with the egg he picked up.

plain: A man named Jake Barber is said to have made contact with his mind, a "consciousness contact", with an egg-shaped object he picked up. Steven Greer, an activist who has long pushed for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, passes this on as something Barber has said. If true, it would mean these objects can respond to human thought.
